goal: CSRF, XSS, iframe sandbox, and file upload security audit across backend & frontend.
summary: Completed comprehensive CSRF defense, Content-Security-Policy (CSP) headers, external iframe sandboxing, file upload scanning, and XSS/HTML neutralization audit across backend and frontend. Implemented Fetch Metadata-aware CSRF protection (Sec-Fetch-Site and Origin verification with custom header fallback for cookie-authenticated mutating requests; Bearer token immunity preserved). Enforced Content-Security-Policy containing frame-ancestors, script-src, and object-src 'none' across FastAPI response middleware and production Nginx reverse proxy configurations. Restored strict iframe sandbox attributes on external 360 and Sketchfab embeds. Hardened file upload handling against executable/script extensions (.exe, .php, .html, .sh, .js), binary signatures (MZ, ELF, #!), and embedded script payloads. Neutralized XSS vectors in user inputs (registration display names, profile updates, inquiry messages, partner notes) with strict validation.

files_modified.changes: Added verify_csrf dependency and function to enforce Fetch Metadata (Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site rejection), Origin header validation, custom anti-CSRF header checks (X-Requested-With, X-CSRF-Token), and Bearer token exemption for state-mutating requests.
Wired verify_map_admin_csrf to centralized verify_csrf(request, require_custom_header=True) ensuring cookie-authenticated map mutations require custom anti-CSRF headers.
Added verify_csrf to update_partner_inquiry_status and update_creator_consent. Added SCRIPT_PATTERN validation and HTML tag stripping on partner notes to reject script injection.
Added input validation on display_name during user registration to strictly reject script/HTML tags (<, >) and invalid characters with HTTP 400 INVALID_DISPLAY_NAME.
Updated _is_valid_display_name to support common punctuation in legitimate names while strictly rejecting HTML tags and non-alphanumeric/non-Latin characters.
Hardened upload_avatar against executable and script extensions (.exe, .php, .html, .js, .sh), binary executable headers (MZ, ELF, #!), and embedded script/HTML payloads.
Updated CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY constant to explicitly include script-src 'self' alongside frame-ancestors 'none' and object-src 'none'.
Added production Content-Security-Policy header with frame-ancestors, script-src, and object-src 'none'.
Added production Content-Security-Policy header with frame-ancestors, script-src, and object-src 'none'.
Added Content-Security-Policy header across HTTP and HTTPS server blocks with frame-ancestors, script-src, and object-src 'none'.
Added sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-popups" to external 360 viewer iframe element.

Created complete 10-test security audit verification suite covering CSRF rejection, negative abuse forged cross-site partner mutation denial, XSS payload neutralization, malicious upload rejection, CSP headers, and iframe sandboxing.

invariants_verified.csrf_cross_site_rejection: State-mutating requests (POST, PATCH, DELETE) authenticated via ambient session cookies with Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site or untrusted Origin are rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden.
invariants_verified.csrf_custom_header_enforcement: Cookie-authenticated administrative operations require a custom anti-CSRF header (X-Requested-With, X-CSRF-Token, or X-XSRF-Token).
invariants_verified.csrf_bearer_exemption: Direct API calls carrying Authorization: Bearer <token> headers are immune to ambient browser CSRF and succeed without requiring anti-CSRF headers.
invariants_verified.forged_partner_mutation_denied: Forged cross-site partner status mutations attempting to advance or alter inquiry states without legitimate origin or same-site context are denied with HTTP 403 Forbidden.
invariants_verified.csp_frame_and_script_restriction: Content-Security-Policy response headers enforce frame-ancestors, script-src, and object-src 'none' across both API middleware and Nginx configurations.
invariants_verified.iframe_restricted_sandbox: External embedded iframes (Sketchfab 3D models and VR 360 tours) strictly use sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-popups", preventing top-level navigations, form submissions, and plugin execution.
invariants_verified.file_upload_executable_rejection: Upload endpoints reject files with executable and script extensions (.exe, .php, .html, .sh, .js), binary executable signatures (MZ, ELF, #!), and embedded scripts.
invariants_verified.xss_input_neutralization: User-generated inputs (registration display names, profile updates, inquiry messages, partner notes) strictly neutralize or reject script patterns and HTML tags.
